notes: Phase 4, first part: told, not asking, and a usage meter. Shivo Cloud tells PCs when something changed (files/worker Live Durable Object per account, /v1/live, hibernating websockets; poke on every change and key request); the PC syncs within ~2 s and keeps only a 10-minute backup round instead of asking every 20 s (~4,000 requests a day per PC).
